data.name: Mishaalat
data.gender_notes: Mishaalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mishaalat is the name of a woman who guards the bridge between this world and the hereafter, ensuring the safe passage of souls. The name Mishaalat carries the meaning “Guardian of the bridge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mishaalat usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian of the bridge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mishaalat is a name with deep spiritual meaning. It is a reminder of the infinite and eternal nature of the universe, and of the interconnectedness of all things. It is a name that inspires awe and reverence, and is a reminder of the power and majesty of Allah.
data.etymology: Mishaalat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian of the bridge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mishaalat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: ميشالات
in_arabic.meaning: ميشالات تعني الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و اللغة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ميشالات مشتق من الجذر العربي م-ش-ل و يعني الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و اللغة. و في اللغة العربية, يعني الاسم القوة و الرفعة في العمل و الحياة. و في القرآن الكريم, لا يوجد ذكر مباشر للاسم, لكن الجذر يستخدم في عدة آيات لتعبر عن الرفعة و العزة.

in_urdu.name: میشالات
in_urdu.meaning: میشالات کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور علو درجات
in_urdu.long_meaning: میشالات نام عربی جڑ م-ش-ل سے ماخوذ ہے, جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور علو درجات. یہ نام اردو زبان میں بھی رائج ہے اور مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک اچھا انتخاب ہے. اس نام کے حاملین کو زندگی میں رفعت اور عزت حاصل ہوتی ہے.

in_hindi.name: मिशालात
in_hindi.meaning: मिशालात का अर्थ है ऊंचाई और उत्कृष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिशालात नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई और उत्कृष्टता. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी लोकप्रिय है और इसे बच्चों के लिए एक अच्छा विकल्प माना जाता है. इस नाम के धारकों को जीवन में उच्चतम स्तर की प्राप्ति होती है.

in_pashto.name: ميشالاټ
in_pashto.meaning: ميشالاټ د لوړوالي او عزت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ميشالاټ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی, چې معنی يې لوړوالي او عزت ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دوديزو کې کارول کيږي او د مسلمانانو لپاره يو ښه انتخاب دی. د دې نوم حاملين په ژوند کې لوړوالي او عزت ترلاسه کوي.

in_english.name: Mishaalat
in_english.meaning: Mishaalat means elevation, excellence, and high status
in_english.long_meaning: Mishaalat is derived from the Arabic root 'm-sh-l', signifying elevation, excellence, and high status. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root is used in various verses to denote dignity and grandeur. The name Mishaalat holds spiritual significance, symbolizing a person's aspiration for high moral character and noble deeds. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, reflecting the values of honor, integrity, and excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The concept of Mishaalat, or the guardian of the bridge, is rooted in Islamic eschatology, depicting a significant role played by an individual in the spiritual transition from this world to the hereafter. This idea resonates with themes of protection and guidance that are deeply ingrained in many aspects of Islamic culture, particularly in areas related to mourning, healing, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Mishaalat represents an offering of protection, reassurance, and guidance to those on the journey to the afterlife. The role of Mishaalat highlights the belief in the interconnectedness of life and death, reflecting the understanding that the choices and actions made in this world impact the ultimate destination of the soul. The figure of Mishaalat serves as a reminder of the greater spiritual journey that lies beyond our physical existence and the importance of striving for spiritual growth and developing good character while in this world.
